description: Holds branch review project analysis records, linked to branch review header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report branch review project analysis records, including amounts and quantities, for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one branch review project analysis.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the branch review project analysis.

columns.name: header_id
columns.description: Reference to the branch review header linked to this branch review project analysis.

columns.name: hot_fl
columns.description: Hot fl of the branch review project analysis.

columns.name: hot_scout
columns.description: Hot scout of the branch review project analysis.

columns.name: warm_fl
columns.description: Warm fl of the branch review project analysis.

columns.name: warm_scout
columns.description: Warm scout of the branch review project analysis.

columns.name: cool_fl
columns.description: Cool fl of the branch review project analysis.

columns.name: cool_scout
columns.description: Cool scout of the branch review project analysis.

columns.name: total
columns.description: Total of the branch review project analysis.

relationships.description: Each branch review project analysis references one branch review header (header).

business_rules: Use total for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to Branch Review Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.

common_metrics.name: Average Total per branch review project analysis

common_queries: Branch Review Project Analysis by branch review header
Top branch review header by total

known_issues: The table appeared empty (estimated 0 rows) when the metadata was last read.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name BranchReviewProjectAnalysis (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting branch review project analysis records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(total) for totals of total.
To resolve names, join on: header_id = BranchReviewHeader.Id.
